headline: SK Hynix Just Had Its Best Quarter Ever: The Stock Is Down 53% From Peak
summary: SK hynix earned more in one quarter than in all of 2025, with a 76% operating margin. The stock fell 9.61% anyway, closing out its worst month in 24 years. The gap between the earnings and the tape is where the real story is.
